metadata.description: Environment short name (staging | prod).
Azure region. Singapore for PDPA.
App Service Plan SKU.
Postgres SKU.
Postgres tier.
Postgres admin username.
Postgres admin password (typically from KV secret, passed via CI --parameters override).
Postgres backup retention days. Prod overrides to 35.

Enable geo-redundant Postgres backups. NOTE: the paired region for southeastasia is East Asia (Hong Kong), so enabling this copies member/claims data OUT of Singapore. Leave false unless that has been signed off against PDPA.
Postgres data disk size. IOPS is derived from it, NOT from the compute SKU: 32GiB=120, 64GiB=240, 128GiB=500, 256GiB=1100. 32GiB is the throughput floor.
Enable zone-redundant Postgres HA. Not supported on the Burstable tier, and roughly doubles cost (a standby duplicates compute+storage).
Redis SKU.
Redis size.

Provision Redis at all. Both consumers degrade gracefully without it — the AI response cache falls back to in-memory and SlowAPI to per-process counters (see app/services/ai_cache.py and app/core/rate_limit.py) — so non-prod can skip the cost. Prod keeps it: per-process rate-limit counters would multiply every limit by the worker count.
Entra tenant ID.
Entra client ID for the API app registration.
CORS origins (comma-separated).
Fully-qualified container image, e.g. insproacr.azurecr.io/inspro-api:<sha>. The CI must build+push the image before passing this in.
Signing secret for employee-portal member JWTs (min 32 chars). The app refuses to boot in prod without one — generate with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))"

Fernet master key that decrypts per-tenant BYOK AI keys (client_ai_configs). Vertex/Gemini BYOK is the sole AI path in prod, so without this every decrypt fails and AI silently falls closed. Generate with: python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"
ACR registry hostname for the webapp to pull from, e.g. insproacr.azurecr.io.
Resource group holding the shared container registry.
Web app / hostname. Defaults to inspro-<env>-api; prod uses inspro-portal so the public URL is inspro-portal.azurewebsites.net.
Apex domain for tenant-per-subdomain routing. Empty on single-host deployments (no custom domain).
How HR/portal requests name their tenant. "subdomain" needs wildcard DNS + a wildcard cert; "header" is for a single shared hostname.
Gunicorn worker processes. Keep at or below the plan vCPU count — it also divides the AI concurrency limit and multiplies the DB pool.
SQLAlchemy pool size PER WORKER. Ceiling is workers x (pool + overflow) x instances; keep it under the server max_connections.
SQLAlchemy overflow connections per worker.

Integrate the web app with the VNet so it reaches Postgres over the private endpoint. Setting this to false stops NEW deployments wiring the subnet, but does not tear down existing integration — for a rollback run `az webapp vnet-integration remove` as well, which reverts the app to the public path.
Notification email for HTTP 5xx alerts (optional).
Portal OTP mail delivery mode. The app refuses to boot in prod with "log" (OTP codes would land in application logs in cleartext).
SMTP host for portal OTP mail (mailMode=smtp). Sends fail visibly (mail_sent=false) until configured.
SMTP port.
SMTP username (also the default From address).
From address for portal OTP mail (defaults to smtpUser).
SMTP password (passed via CI --parameters override).

properties.description: The oldest available claim-review job exceeded the configured queue-age threshold.
A lease, provider, terminal-job, or state-invariant failure requires attention.

allOf.query:
traces
            | extend code = tostring(customDimensions.error_code)
            | where code == "lease_expired"
                or code startswith "ai_configuration"
                or code in ("pending_without_job", "active_missing_record")
                or message == "Claim-review job terminated"

Azure region. Must match the app and the database — regional VNet integration requires all three in the same region.
Existing Postgres Flexible Server to place behind a private endpoint.
VNet address space. 10.0.0.0/16 and 10.1.0.0/16 are already taken by rg-ivm and rg-supabase-sea in this subscription.
Subnet delegated to App Service for regional VNet integration. Microsoft recommends at least a /26 — App Service consumes addresses per instance during scale and slot swaps.
Subnet holding the Postgres private endpoint NIC.
